title: Why COMMUNICATION is the key for Bo Nix, Davis Webb, Broncos as they face Rams | Orange & Blue Today
text: It’s a Wednesday edition of Orange & Blue Today, and Mase and Cecil continue the deep dive into Broncos vs Rams on Sunday Night Football — a matchup shaped heavily by injuries, adjustments, and what we’ve learned through two weeks of the 2026 season. The running back room is once again the headline. JK Dobbins is battling a hamstring issue — will he be close to full strength. RJ Harvey could be a sneaky difference‑maker against the Rams because of his burst and space skills. And then there’s Jonah Coleman, who left Week 2 dinged up — does he have a high‑ankle sprain, and how does that impact the rotation heading into Sunday night. On offense, the conversation shifts to Bo Nix and his growing connection with Davis Webb. Webb’s communication, clarity, and ability to translate concepts have stood out through the first two weeks. What have we learned about their working relationship, and how does that help Nix attack a Rams secondary built on disguise and post‑snap movement. 🔥 In this episode: Broncos RB injuries and what they mean for Sunday night JK Dobbins’ status and whether he can handle a full workload RJ Harvey’s role and why he could pop Jonah Coleman’s injury and how it affects the rotation Bo Nix and Davis Webb — what we’ve learned through two weeks Drop your thoughts — who should lead the Broncos backfield on Sunday night.
